# Play — Swan Lake

- SudokuPad: [Swan Lake on SudokuPad](https://sudokupad.)
- f-puzzles: [Swan Lake on f-puzzles](https://www.f-puzzles.com/?)

Both links carry the same f-puzzles JSON (lz-string compressed), including the solution, so SudokuPad can check your answer.
The sandwich sums are native (`sandwichsum`). Graceful lines are an invented rule, so the apps show them as plain blue
lines and can't check them: read the rule in [rules.md](rules.md). The lake is a straight line in the apps (the wave is
only in `grid.svg`). I have not opened the links in a browser. If anything looks off, use `grid.svg` in this folder as
the reference picture.

Graceful lines: r2c2–r2c3–r3c4–r4c4–r5c3–r6c3–r7c4–r8c5–r8c6; r7c5–r6c6–r5c7–r6c8–r7c9–r8c8–r8c7; r9c1–r9c2–r9c3–r9c4–r9c5–r9c6–r9c7–r9c8–r9c9.

Sandwich sums (position = total; r0 = above, c0 = left): r0c2 = 22; r0c3 = 32; r0c7 = 33; r2c0 = 31; r3c0 = 6; r5c0 = 33; r7c0 = 27.

Fallback: `puzzle.json` in this folder is the machine-readable source (constraints, solution).
